channel.title: LaGrange Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from LaGrange Daily News (lagrangenews.com)

item.title: LaGrange Academy punches ticket to region championship game
item.description: LaGrange Academy crushed Flint River in the region semifinals to earn a home shot at the region title Thursday

item.title: Council discusses potential voting changes
item.description: Election officials outline plans to move early voting and election offices from the courthouse to a Whitesville Road site and consolidate precincts to improve access and cut costs.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Lynn Gendusa: Where Have All the Flowers Gone?
item.description: Lynn Gendusa reflects on Oxford’s icy devastation, Ole Miss’s violent past, and Minnesota’s bloodshed to ask if we’ll ever thaw our hearts to hatred and political violence.

item.title: TOTY Alford leads with creativity and kindness
item.description: Gardner Newman Middle School art teacher Braily Alford, known for her creative, kind classroom, is named Teacher of the Year after seven years in Troup County schools.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Bill King: Icicle Pickles and Icicle Pickleballs
item.description: From garden gluts to frozen courts, Bill King traces how icicle pickles led to icy pickleball games—and a reminder to do what matters, even when it’s probably too cold.

item.title: West Point approves outsourcing of new housing inspections
item.description: West Point council approves contract to outsource all building inspections to Charles Abbott Associates, adding new housing reviews at a reduced 60% rate and creating a public records database.

item.description: Troup County Sheriff's Office Incident Reports for period ending Feb. 11

item.title: TCSB approves school zone boundary changes
item.description: Troup County schools will shift attendance zones in fall 2026 after the board approved a plan to ease crowding and clarify boundaries at several elementary schools.

item.title: LaGrange Memorial Library to host America250 programs
item.description: LaGrange Memorial Library will host free monthly America250 talks on key U.S. military events, led by retired Army Col. Gerry Tertychny, from Desert Storm to Midway.

item.title: LaGrange wins season opener
item.description: Jase Foster and Nolan Haines broke a late tie as LaGrange edged rival Columbus 4-2 in its 2026 season opener
